description: This file defines a set of React components for a customizable UI menubar, utilizing Radix UI primitives and lucide icons. It includes components like Menubar, MenubarTrigger, MenubarContent, and various menu items, with styling and behavior encapsulated.

methods.name: Menubar
methods.description: Main container component for the menubar, forwarding ref to Radix UI Root.

methods.name: MenubarTrigger
methods.description: Component for the trigger button that opens the menu, with styling and focus states.

methods.name: MenubarSubTrigger
methods.description: Component for submenu trigger with optional inset styling.

methods.name: MenubarSubContent
methods.description: Component for submenu content with animated and styled container.

methods.name: MenubarContent
methods.description: Component for the main menu content, positioned with portal and animated.

methods.name: MenubarItem
methods.description: Standard menu item with focus and disabled states.

methods.name: MenubarRadioItem
methods.description: Radio button menu item with indicator.

methods.name: MenubarShortcut
methods.description: Display for keyboard shortcuts associated with menu items.
